verdict.rationale: Airbyte lets users schedule connection syncs as Scheduled, Cron, or Manual, and scheduled ones run unattended in the background. Supporting pieces include post-sync dbt transformations, email/webhook notifications, and a connection timeline with logs for monitoring. Setup can also be automated through the API, Airflow orchestration, or Terraform, and a community user reports syncs continuing 'happily' on their own. The automation is limited to data-pipeline syncs rather than agent-driven background tasks. Missing for 10: autonomous AI/agent-triggered automations beyond scheduled syncs, independent hands-on corroboration of scheduling reliability.
